description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for a control plane module, including callback registration, control plane initialization, start/stop, and key-value mapping functions.

methods.name: UT_ControlPlane_Init
methods.description: Initializes a control plane instance with a specified monitor port.

methods.name: UT_ControlPlane_RegisterCallbackOnMessage
methods.description: Registers a callback function for a specific message key in the control plane.

methods.name: UT_ControlPlane_Start
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming control plane messages.

methods.name: UT_ControlPlane_Stop
methods.description: Stops listening for control plane messages.

methods.name: UT_ControlPlane_Exit
methods.description: Releases resources and destroys a control plane instance.

methods.name: UT_Control_GetMapValue
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped value for a given search string from a key-value map.

methods.name: UT_Control_GetMapString
methods.description: Retrieves the string mapped to a given key from a key-value map.
